entries.title: A task's tags stay inside its hover summary
entries.body: When a task carries several tags, the Tags line in its hover summary now wraps onto more lines inside the summary, the way the task's title does. Before, a long list of tags ran past the summary's right edge.

picture.alt: A task's hover summary with six tags, Bug, Enhancement, Refactor, Reliability, Security and Test system, wrapped over three lines inside the summary
